name: Magram Village
summary: In southeastern Desolace, the Magram hold their village amid foul yellow pools. They use it as a base in their war against the Gelkis, their hated rivals.

sections.title: A Stronghold in the Mire
sections.body: Stagnant yellow pools ring the islands and shores where the Magram make their home in southeastern Desolace. Crude wooden bridges cross the mire, joining their hide tents. The clan keeps watch against its neighbors and is known for brutality and deep hatred of the southern Gelkis. Outsiders find no welcome unless they prove their worth by slaughtering Gelkis enemies.

faq.answer: The Magram clan lives in the village, one of several centaur tribes native to Desolace. They shelter beneath crude hide canopies on islands joined by rough footbridges.

faq.q: Can I enter Magram Village without being attacked?
faq.answer: The Magram are hostile to outsiders at first. Travelers can earn their trust by hunting and killing their sworn enemies, the Gelkis, and raising their standing with the clan.

faq.q: Why are the pools around the village yellow?
faq.answer: Sulfur and mineral runoff taint the pools around the village. The stagnant water is discolored and polluted in Desolace's barren wastes.

faq.q: Why are the Magram fighting the Gelkis?
faq.answer: The Magram and Gelkis are bound by a legendary, bloodthirsty rivalry among the centaur clans. For generations, they have fought for dominance over Desolace's southern reaches.

angles.text: As a tauren, you know centaur savagery has plagued Kalimdor's tribes for generations. A settlement of these nomadic marauders recalls past bloodshed.
